description: Structural requirements for all compiled API route handlers

rules.description: Handler must be exported as a named async function: export async function handle(...)
schema.ts must export InputSchema and OutputSchema as named exports
All error responses must use shape: { error: string, code?: string, details?: unknown }
All success responses must use shape: { data: T } or { data: T, meta: { total, page, ... } }
req.body, req.query, req.params must be accessed only after schema.parse() — never directly
Auth check must occur before any business logic or DB calls on protected routes
Handler must be async and all awaited operations must be wrapped in try/catch
Handler must set Content-Type: application/json on all responses
